title: Wellness Reset — Mid-Year Health Campaign
objective: Position a healthcare provider as the trusted wellness partner for post-monsoon season health concerns; drive 150+ qualified patient enquiries and establish thought leadership via educational content.
target_audience: Urban professionals 28–50, families with school-age children, wellness-conscious individuals in Yangon
key_activities: 3-week educational content series (immunity, allergy relief, preventive care) across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook
5 short-form doctor testimonial videos (2–3 min each) shot in-clinic
Carousel posts + reels covering July health concerns (post-monsoon fatigue, seasonal colds, vitamin boosters)
Influencer seeding: 3 mid-tier wellness creators sharing personal health stories linked to the provider
Retargeting campaign targeting website visitors + past patient lookalikes
kpis: 150+ qualified patient enquiries (tracked via unique UTM codes)
8%+ engagement rate on educational content (target benchmark 4–6%)
why_now: July marks the tail of monsoon season; patients are seeking post-illness recovery care and preventive solutions. School holidays mean families are more engaged with health-related content. This is peak season for clinics to convert awareness into appointments before August holiday exodus.
deliverables: Content calendar (21 posts across 3 weeks)
5 doctor testimonial videos (2–3 min each, ready for social)
12 carousel + reel graphics (immunity, allergy, wellness tips)
3 influencer seeding briefs + performance tracking
Retargeting ad set (3 variants: rational/emotional/disruptive copy)
Weekly performance report (reach, engagement, enquiries, cost-per-lead)

title: Health & Vitality Expo — July Wellness Festival
objective: Host a 1-day community health expo for 400+ attendees; showcase multiple healthcare providers, wellness vendors, and fitness brands; generate 200+ qualified leads and build brand authority in the wellness space.
target_audience: Health-conscious families 25–55, fitness enthusiasts, corporate wellness decision-makers, gym members
key_activities: Full event production: 400-pax capacity, 4–5 health vendor booths, 2 fitness brand activations
Stage programming: 3 expert talks (nutritionist, physiotherapist, mental health counselor), 2 live fitness demos
Interactive zones: free health screenings (BP, BMI, blood sugar), wellness quiz booth, corporate wellness lounge
Influencer + media coverage: 5 wellness creators live-streaming, 2 media outlets on-site
Lead capture: QR sign-up wall, digital forms at every booth, post-event email nurture
kpis: 200+ qualified leads captured (with contact + health interest data)
5M+ earned media impressions (livestreams, media coverage, social mentions)
4.2K+ social media posts from attendees (#hashtag tracking)
3.5K new followers across sponsor/venue social accounts
why_now: July school holidays drive family attendance; wellness is a prime topic post-monsoon. This timing captures health-conscious consumers in a high-intent moment. Corporate wellness budgets are often allocated mid-year; the expo serves as a B2B + B2C bridge.
deliverables: Event concept deck (layout, vendor map, stage schedule)
Run-of-show with detailed timings (setup, talks, demos, pack-down)
Vendor recruitment + briefing (5 vendor confirmations)
Stage production: audio, lighting, 2 LED screens, live-streaming setup
Event collateral: banners, signage, programs, digital lead forms
Social content: 20+ reels/stories during event, 5 influencer livestream briefs
Post-event report: attendance data, lead quality scoring, earned media summary, 7-day follow-up campaign

title: School Holiday Fitness Bootcamp — Youth Activation
objective: Launch a 2-week youth fitness activation targeting families during school holidays; drive 300+ sign-ups for fitness classes, position a wellness center as the go-to summer destination, and capture email + social followers for Q3 conversion.
target_audience: Families with kids 8–17, young adults 18–30, health-conscious parents seeking summer activity options
key_activities: Pop-up fitness bootcamp at a high-traffic mall/park (2 weeks, daily 90-min sessions: kids yoga, HIIT, dance)
Influencer co-hosting: 4 micro-fitness creators leading sessions, creating reels from the activity
Social contest: attendees tag #BootcampFit + follow brand for daily prizes (water bottles, class passes, merch)
Email capture: sign-ups get a free trial class + summer fitness plan (weekly nurture thereafter)
On-site content: 40+ photos/videos daily for social repurposing
kpis: 6.5% engagement rate on UGC posts (vs benchmark 3–4%)
why_now: School holidays (July) are peak family leisure time in Myanmar; parents actively seek activities for children. Fitness is a high-intent category in summer (heat + indoor air-con appeal). This activation captures families in a buying mood before Q3 school return.
deliverables: Activation site setup: 2-week pop-up schedule, equipment, safety protocols
Class programming: daily schedule (kids yoga, HIIT, dance; 90 min each)
4 influencer co-hosting briefs + daily content calendars
Social contest mechanics: prize fulfillment, daily reels (14 reels, 2 per class type)
On-site photography & video: 200+ images, 8 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels format)
Email nurture sequence: welcome + 4-week summer fitness plan (templated, branded)
Post-activation report: sign-ups, trial conversions, email list quality, cost-per-booking, influencer lift

title: Mental Wellness Month — Content + Community Campaign
objective: Build a mental health awareness & destigmatization campaign; drive 120+ therapy/counseling enquiries for a wellness center, grow social community to 4K followers, and position the brand as a trusted mental health advocate in Yangon.
target_audience: Urban professionals 22–45, students, corporate employees seeking mental health support, families with anxiety/stress concerns
key_activities: 4-week content series: real therapist talks (10 min each), stress-relief exercises, mental health myths-busting posts
3 deep-dive documentary-style videos (patient testimonials, therapist expert interviews, 8–12 min each)
Live Q&A sessions: 2 weekly Zoom talks (therapist + community), promoted heavily on Instagram/Facebook
Partner activation: 3 corporate partners (banks, tech firms) for internal mental health awareness (B2B angle)
Paid retargeting: target past website visitors + lookalikes with 'first session free' offer
kpis: 35+ mental health support bookings (from enquiries → conversion)
why_now: July is a natural moment for mental wellness focus (mid-year stress, monsoon mood impacts, back-to-school anxiety). Global Mental Health Day (July 10) provides a cultural peg. Post-monsoon fatigue + school holiday transitions make emotional wellbeing a relevant conversation. Corporate wellness budgets are active mid-year.
deliverables: Content calendar (28 organic posts + 12 paid ad creatives)
3 documentary-style videos (8–12 min each: testimonial, expert talk, myth-busting)
12 short-form reels (stress-relief tips, mental health myths, therapist Q&As)
2 live Q&A session briefs + promotion graphics
3 corporate partnership decks (mental health awareness program proposals)
Email nurture sequence: 4-week 'mental wellness' educational series
Paid ad set: 3 creative variants (emotional/rational/curiosity-driven) + audience targeting
Campaign report: reach, engagement, enquiries, bookings, email growth, corporate partner feedback

title: Summer Wellness Challenge — Lead Generation & Retention Campaign
objective: Gamify summer fitness engagement; capture 280+ qualified leads for a fitness/wellness center; drive 90+ trial memberships; build a 6-week habit loop that converts to annual memberships by September.
target_audience: Fitness novices 25–45, young professionals, families with fitness goals, weight-loss seekers
key_activities: 8-week guided challenge: participants track daily activity (steps, classes, nutrition logs) via a branded app/landing page
Tiered rewards: weekly winners (nutrition packs, class passes), final grand prize (3-month free membership + coaching)
Daily email + SMS nudges: motivational messages, exercise tips, leaderboard updates
Influencer ambassadors: 3 fitness creators sharing their daily challenge updates, cross-promoting to their audiences
Social amplification: weekly challenge highlights, user spotlights, transformation stories (consent-based)
kpis: 90+ trial memberships converted (32% conversion rate from sign-up)
55+ annual memberships (from trial pool, by end of Sept)
why_now: July school holidays align with family wellness goals and summer fitness motivation. An 8-week challenge (July–Sept) bridges holiday season into term-time, creating habit stickiness by September when annual gym memberships typically spike. Summer is high-intent for fitness + health seekers.
deliverables: Challenge mechanics document (rules, rewards, tiers, timeline)
Landing page (sign-up form, challenge info, FAQs, testimonials)
Email nurture sequence: 6-week daily + weekly digest template (templated, branded, 42 emails)
SMS template library (10 motivational/reminder messages, schedulable)
3 influencer ambassador briefs + content calendar (daily updates, 8 weeks)
Weekly leaderboard + social spotlight graphics (8 graphics + 8 user stories)
Trial conversion flow: automated trial booking page + follow-up sequence
Challenge tracking dashboard (sign-ups, trial conversions, membership closes, engagement data)
8-week campaign report: sign-ups, trial conversions, memberships, email engagement, ROI per channel
